name: Muroi Kunio
source:
Work: Diplomat
Hobby: Cooking, cars

Kunio is a charming, down-to-earth guy who's good at cooking and keeping his apartment clean. He loves classic Japanese cars and is knowledgeable about Octokitty. With his good looks and high paying job in the government, he seems too good to be true.
